name: git-workflow
description: Common Git operations: commit, branch, merge, rebase, stash, log

snippets.name: git-clean-branches
snippets.content: git branch --merged | grep -v "\*" | grep -v "master" | grep -v "main" | xargs -n 1 git branch -d

snippets.name: git-force-pull
snippets.content: git fetch origin && git reset --hard origin/$(git branch --show-current)
